text: i do not see a paint dbg. are you sure we are looking at the same editor ?
resolution: User reported no [paintdbg] log appeared on press — proof the IsoAuthor handler I'd instrumented wasn't the one firing. Traced the editor mount (index.tsx): both LoaderIsoView (live loader pane, the primary build surface) and IsoAuthor (React authoring twin) are mounted, and EACH has its own private drag-paint gate. The user places in LoaderIsoView, whose paintKindOf still read the raw 'prop' kind. Identified this as the surface to fix; done in req_1964.
